disposition_reason: Figure 2b supplies an ordered held-neuron prediction task, but its numeric baseline and exact historical execution are unresolved. The local source correction and trial-occurrence adapter do not establish native target isolation or paper parity. Changing to a new blocked split or a training-only PSTH is an extension, not victory over Figure 2b.

source_paper.title: Reciprocal connections dynamically build consensus between neocortical areas

evidence.locator: Results: The model captures trial-by-trial variability; Figure 2a,b; Methods model fitting/selection
evidence.supports: Held-neuron Poisson prediction against a same-condition PSTH; 246 active neurons in seven animals; constrained and unconstrained model comparisons.
Default cached heldout route, 5 ms binning, full-pool leave-current-trial-out PSTH, indexed splits and held-neuron evaluation.

evidence.locator: trial_ids, select_condition, get_partial_prms and training split construction
evidence.supports: Native fitting configuration and source trial ordering must match the analysis path.
Training prefix and remaining test suffix are literal occurrence partitions.

evidence.locator: article version 1; files and folder_structure metadata
evidence.supports: Versioned seven-animal source deposit and native/NPY trial permutation companions; metadata only was acquired.

target.description: Predict the held neuron’s single-trial firing-rate trajectory from the other simultaneously observed V1/LM neurons; Figure 2b residual Poisson log-likelihood is the original ordered target.

dataset.description: Figshare article 30983044 version 1, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.30983044.v1; authenticate file IDs and folder identities before acquisition.

cohort.description: Retain all seven animals and the paper’s active-cell criterion (reported 246 neurons); the exact deposited inclusion/window/mask has not been reconciled to that census.

split.description: Retain all three original folds and their source trial occurrences. The code indexes trial_ids before selection and partitions a training prefix; authentic native permutation/configuration parity remains unresolved. Do not repair or replace folds silently.

inputs.description: Other-neuron spikes and original stimulus/condition timing are available for the query; the target’s current-trial spikes must be absent from recognition observations and all target-derived features.

preprocessing.description: Source uses dt=0.005 and removes the first 500 ms. Exact native mask/slice semantics and historical analysis configuration need qualification before inferring the original fitted inputs.

metric.description: Residual LL = sum_t[y_t log(mu_t)-mu_t-lgamma(y_t+1)] minus the same sum for the leave-current-trial-out condition PSTH; mu is expected count per 5 ms bin. Higher is better.

aggregation.description: Reconcile trial/condition averaging and three-fold neuron summaries with Figure 2b, retaining every animal and active neuron; do not substitute bits/spike or an equal-animal score for the source figure statistic.

published_baseline.description: No authenticated numeric Figure 2b model score or complete per-neuron reference was recovered. Reported significance and neuron counts are not performance baselines.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No native rerun is established. The author route is examples/fit_single_animal.ml plus analyze_fitted_model.ml; rerun_heldout=false and held-neuron slice/order questions prevent calling that route qualified.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful residual-LL gain must be set using source units and author rerun variability after parity, without turning a reconstruction tolerance into an improvement margin.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired animal-level interval/decision rule after resolving the original endpoint; retain neuron/trial nesting and report all seven animal effects.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Animal; neurons, trials and folds are nested/repeated.
uncertainty.rationale: Seven animals, not 246 independent biological replicates. No threshold or interval coverage has been invented.

paper_win_requires: Recover the numeric Figure 2b baseline and original trial/condition aggregation with complete seven-animal, three-fold support.
Resolve native held-target isolation, cached predictions and source-occurrence semantics before interpreting a gain.
Compare with both original constrained and unconstrained models under identical original inputs and PSTH definition.
Freeze candidate, meaningful effect, uncertainty and access/resource budgets before final evaluation.
A new trial split, training-only PSTH, reduced neuron cohort or higher line-attractor score cannot establish this paper win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison has been verified; source-paper reproduction and same-task improvement are separate outcomes.

episode.improvement_loop: Disabled pending source reconciliation. Once admitted, iterate using only original training/development observations and matched feedback.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze source/configuration/dependencies and every selection decision before owner evaluation of the original target queries.
episode.final_evaluation: Run the complete original Figure 2b endpoint only after historical parity and independent evaluator validation; public-source exposure remains disclosed.
episode.baseline_policy: Preserve reported, independently rerun author, and candidate scores separately. The corrected successor must not be relabelled as the historical author baseline. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.

blocking_issues: Numeric Figure 2b baseline and aggregation are unrecovered.
Native OCaml/Owl held-neuron slices, cached-output bypass, trial occurrence ordering and active-cell census remain unresolved.
Original model selection exposure and full-pool PSTH must be accounted for.
No complete native reference, evaluator, justified effect rule or fixed episode budgets.

legacy.notes: Preserve the original task and its held-neuron correction/trial-occurrence components as calibration evidence. Invented indexing controls are not scientific reproduction or improvement.
